slope_fit: weighted straight-line fit to log air/vac ratio over all 32 distances; fixed diagonal bootstrap variance weights; entire source-library batches resampled to estimate uncertainty. Correlated distance estimates, not a full GLS fit; CI conditional on model and limited batches.
caveats: Geant4 emitter diameter 22 mm but analytical model emitter diameter 9.75 mm; aperture diameter 9.75 mm, not necessarily active diameter.
Geant4 and analytical geometry use 18 mm; experimental M3 profiles a common offset around 18 ± 1.5 mm and finds 19.04 mm.
Geant4 includes assumed 10 keV threshold, source housing/foil/acrylic and detector response, not present in analytical efficiency.
Independent air and vacuum batches; source histories reused across distances; no inverse of rank-limited 32x32 MC covariance.
MC intervals exclude geometry, materials, spectrum and threshold systematics; experimental profile interval excludes response model uncertainty.
Unnormalised Geant4 air/vac is a model-dependent response ratio; not measured transmission, nor proof of physical cause.
